messages:
jamie: Quick sync — can we lock a 60m postmortem + RFC review for the scale incident from last Wed? Need timeline, root cause, mitigations, and then a walkthrough of the retry/backoff RFC. Prefer Thu/Fri this week. Attendees: eng leads, SRE, product, support.

akiko: Thu afternoon works for me. 3:30–4:30 PT or 4–5 PT. If we do 60m probably 3:30 so EU folks can join at the tail. Also can we ask folks to add any evidence/graphs to the doc beforehand? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

mike: I can do Fri 10–11 PT as backup. For agenda, propose:
```
1) 10m — timeline + impact summary (Leah)
2) 15m — technical RCA (SRE + runtime)
3) 15m — proposed mitigations + short-term fixes
4) 15m — RFC walkthrough for retry/backoff, discussion, decisions
5) 5m — action owners & next steps
```
If that looks tight we can split into 45m retro + 30m RFC follow-up.

priya: prefer single meeting if we can keep RFC focused to decisions needed now. Also +1 on pre-reads (timeline + perf graphs). Can product prepare user impact summary? @leah can you pull support notes?

leah: yep I'll collate timeline and support queue excerpts. I'll create the retro doc and add a section for owner/action tracking with JIRA tags. Will add links to dashboards under the doc. ETA: EOD today. :white_check_mark:

noah: add a short section for "rollout/canary metrics" and a brief blast radius/rollback playbook snippet — important if we decide to change default backoffs.

deploy-bot: Automated incident timeline available: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0412 — includes deploys, alerts, and pager entries.

jamie: Great. Tentative consensus: Thu 3:30–4:30 PT. I'll send the calendar invite once folks confirm.

akiko: Confirmed for me. :thumbsup:

mike: Confirmed. I'll prep the RFC slide for the 15m walkthrough and mark decisions we need.

priya: Confirmed. Will add the product impact note to the doc.

leah: Added initial timeline + support excerpts. Please drop any logs/graphs before the meeting so we can triage faster.

jamie: Assigning owners for pre-meeting items:
- timeline/support excerpts: leah
- RCA draft (runtime): mike + noah
- product impact note: priya
- RFC slides: mike
- action tracker template + JIRA tags: leah

If anyone else needs to be invited (legal/security) call it out here. Otherwise I'll send invite and link to the doc. Thanks! :calendar:
